techniques.name: 叠加有强度与时间范围的滤镜
techniques.intent: 将多个外观处理表达为有序的非破坏性时间节点。

timing.rule: Each look is active only on its interval; stacking evaluates in declared order.

pitfalls: The proprietary 蒸汽波 look is not defined by the title or screenshot; exact recreation needs a matching licensed LUT/algorithm.
Two copies are not necessarily equal to doubling a single intensity slider.
Look order can change the result; clipping destroys detail.
validation: Compare source and processed frames at the same source timestamp.
Check every look interval boundary for unintended changes.
Inspect clipped channels and confirm the intended stack order.

techniques.name: 时间范围内的调节层与局部预览
techniques.intent: 把调色范围、处理顺序与参数明确分开。

timing.rule: Preview time must fall within the selected node; copy/split changes interval metadata, not source media.

pitfalls: Legacy slider brightness29 is not FFmpeg brightness0.29 and contrast-42 is not a physical contrast ratio.
The exact highlight/shadow algorithms and neutral parameter mapping are unknown.
A layer can extend beyond the source clip and affect other clips unless scoped deliberately.
Stacked corrections can accumulate unwanted tint, clipping or noise.
validation: Neutral settings produce unchanged frames within tolerance.
Frames immediately outside the interval are unchanged.
Inspect before/after at equal source seconds and compare adjacent shots.
Validate working color space before applying SDR adjustments.

unknowns: No audio audition or continuous playback performed.
ASR contains homophone errors; statements about highlight-slider direction are not accepted as calibrated behavior.
Exact proprietary filter assets and slider transfer functions are unavailable.
